description: Sample NDJSON single-record mapping for the BA-facing JSON template (ADR 0018). Worked example: a customer feed where each line is one JSON object with a nested `customer` object and a `transactions` array. Each field carries a `json_path` (JSONPath selector) instead of fixed-width position/length. The `TXN_COUNT` field maps an array path (`$.transactions[*]`) which the JsonParser collapses to an integer count column.

fields.name: CUSTOMER_ID
fields.description: Customer identifier (required). Line 9 omits the customer.id key to exercise the required check.

fields.name: AGE
fields.description: Customer age (numeric). Line 10 carries the string 'NaN' to exercise the decimal data-type check.

fields.name: STATUS
fields.description: Account status code. Line 8 carries 'FROZEN' to exercise the valid_values check.

fields.name: TXN_COUNT
fields.description: Number of transactions on the record. The array path `$.transactions[*]` is collapsed by the JsonParser to an integer count column (TXN_COUNT_count). Line 6 carries an empty transactions array (count 0). Drive a 'must have at least one transaction' rule with the json_array_length operator on this count.
